title: Interactive access timeline + compliance export pipeline
creator: Marco Li
description: Build an interactive access timeline UI and a backend export pipeline that produce tamper-evident, jurisdiction-aware audit packages for periodic access reviews. This ticket covers: (1) schema for access events (provision, role-change, SSO assertion, SCIM deprovision), (2) a streaming collector that aggregates events into a tenant-scoped timeline, (3) an API and export job to produce signed ZIP bundles (CSV + JSONL + provenance manifest), and (4) an embeddable review widget in Console that surfaces anomalies and allows reviewer decisions to be recorded back to the evidence stream. The implementation must be efficient for large tenants (10k+ users) and respect residency and retention policies per tenant configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Event schema v1 defined and documented with examples for SSO/SAML assertions, SCIM provisioning/deprovisioning, and role updates
Streaming collector deployed to staging that groups events by tenant and produces ordered timelines within 30s of event arrival
Export job produces signed bundles including: users.csv, roles.csv, events.jsonl, manifest.json with SHA256 hashes and signing metadata
Console review widget displays timeline for selected user and allows reviewer to record "retain"/"revoke" decisions which are persisted to evidence stream
End-to-end demo run with synthetic tenant of 12k users completes export within SLA (export job < 20 minutes) and bundle verifies with the public key in the manifest
risks_and_mitigations: Large tenant export could OOM: mitigation - stream to disk and chunked archive creation; add memory guardrails and incremental checkpoints
Signing keys management: mitigation - integrate with KMS and rotate keys via key version metadata in manifest
Residency constraints: mitigation - route collector and export jobs into tenant region; include residency tag in manifest and fail export if region mismatch
Latency spikes during high-volume SCIM churn: mitigation - backpressure on collector with per-tenant buffering and adaptive batching
